description: Create client_portal_notices table with severity, localized content jsonb, link_url, starts_at, ends_at, dismissible, audience_type, timestamps
Create client_portal_notice_targets table (client/tag targets per notice)
Create client_portal_notice_dismissals table with unique (tenant, notice, user)
Distribute all three tables on Citus colocated with tenants via the shared migration helper; idempotent; no-op on plain Postgres
Notice types and shared constants (severity, audience type, content shape, message and label length caps)
Validate notice input: default-locale message required, length caps, ends_at after starts_at, severity and audience enums
Validate link URL: https or same-origin relative path only; reject all other schemes
Force dismissible=false for critical severity at write time
Liveness predicate: live when within optional start/end window, evaluated against server time
Derive Live / Scheduled / Expired status for display
Locale resolution: user locale if present in content map, else default
Server action: list notices (settings:read, MSP only) with audience summary names and derived status
Server action: get one notice for editing
Server action: create notice with targets (settings:update, MSP only)
Server action: update notice and replace targets; clear dismissals on content or audience change
Server action: delete notice and its targets and dismissals
Server action: preview audience, returning names of clients an audience resolves to
Portal query: live notices matching the session user's client (all, explicit client, or any shared client tag), excluding that user's dismissals, ordered by severity then recency, in one query
Derive the user's client server-side from the session user's contact; never accept a client id from the request
Server action: dismiss notice for calling user only, refused for non-dismissible or non-visible notices
Load active notices in the client portal server layout and pass them to the client layout
ClientPortalNoticeBar component using standard Alert with severity-to-variant mapping, full width under the header
Render message as plain text and link with target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer
Dismiss control on dismissible notices only; optimistic hide then server persist
Collapse beyond 3 visible notices with a +N more disclosure
Mount notice bar in ClientPortalTopBar beside StaleActionBanner so it shows on every portal page
Client Portal settings: Notices section with DataTable (message preview, severity, audience names, schedule, status chip)
Add/Edit notice dialog: severity, default message, link, schedule, dismissible toggle, audience selector
Audience selector: All clients / Specific clients (client picker) / Clients with tags (tag picker)
Per-locale message repeater with default first
Dismissible toggle disabled and off when severity is critical
Preview of the bar in a chosen locale before saving
Delete confirmation dialog
Stable element ids on all new interactive controls per UI standards
Locale strings for portal bar (dismiss, more, severity labels) and authoring UI in en and the other shipped locales
Permission errors use permissionError with a translated key
